biggest_catch: There is a $0 annual fee, so the $200 bonus is yours to keep net — but existing or previous Cash Rewards accounts do not qualify, and product upgrades to this card are not eligible, so this is genuinely new-applicants-only.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never overspend just to chase a bonus; buying things to hit a threshold wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on this.
Existing and previous Cash Rewards account holders do not qualify; upgrading an existing card to this product does not qualify.
Only eligible net purchases count — returns and credits are netted out.
You must spend at least $1,000 in eligible net purchases within 90 days of account opening.
Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, which can temporarily dip your credit score by a few points.
The card's variable APR (around 20%+) will erase the entire bonus in a month or two if you carry a balance — pay the full statement balance every month.

steps: Go to the official U.S. Bank Cash+ page https://www.usbank.com/credit-cards/cash-plus-visa-signature-credit-card.html and read the $200 / $1,000 terms.
Apply online and get approved; save your approval confirmation.
Spend at least $1,000 in eligible net purchases — your already-planned spending — within 90 days of account opening.
Pay the full statement balance every month so interest never eats the bonus.
Confirm the $200 posts within one to two billing cycles after you qualify.
